parsing.notes: GET /api/v1/juristic_person/{13-digit}. Envelope {status:{code,description}, data:[{cd:OrganizationJuristicPerson:{...}}]}; require status.code == '1000'. JSON keys use XML-namespace prefixes (cd:/td:/cr:). Parse: ID, NameTH/EN, Type, RegisterDate (YYYYMMDD), Status, Objective (TSIC code + TH/EN), RegisterCapital/PaidUpCapital (THB), BranchName, nested Address (CountrySubDivision=province TH-NN, City=district, CitySubDivision=sub-district). 13-digit ID = company id = Tax ID. No bulk endpoint — drive by an ID worklist. No personal data in this endpoint (PDPA-safe).
